measurement_on_real_path.method: built the actual wire body with the real system prompt, the real active history, and the discovered tool schemas, then priced it with the same serialized_bytes the admission guard uses
measurement_on_real_path.verdict: the request is refused before any model call; the compressor never runs, which is why every compression_* counter is clean

concentration.note: one schema alone is 55.9 percent of all tool schema bytes

field_level_cause.what_they_contain: long natural-language catalogues of every supported format and operation, embedded verbatim in the schema text that is sent on every single call

why_the_installed_repair_did_not_cover_i.repair_path: compressor structural fallback when fixed system+tools exceed the soft trigger
why_the_installed_repair_did_not_cover_i.actual_path: bounded-context admission check_request raises BoundedContextOverflowError before the compressor is consulted
why_the_installed_repair_did_not_cover_i.conclusion: the repair is correct for its own class and remains installed; it simply is not the gate that fires here

honest_assessment.evidence: the same three files only ever changed compressor behaviour; tool schema text and the admission budget were untouched, and the pre-install failure had the same shape

candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.what: move the giant format catalogues out of the always-sent schema description and let the tool validate at call time
candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.saves: at least 168835 bytes from the two worst fields
candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.risk: changes the tool-calling contract a model sees; needs its own regression on the document paths that rely on those catalogues

candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.what: increase server_max_input_tokens or the model context pin
candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.risk: only valid if the local Qwen server really accepts the larger prompt; otherwise failures move to the provider

candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.what: do not offer document-writing schemas to a chat profile
candidate_fixes_and_why_each_needs_owner.risk: removes capabilities the owner may expect in that chat

why_owner_input_is_required: all three change either the tool-calling contract or the effective limits of the product model, which the standing rule reserves for an explicit owner decision
